findings.problem: In Latin America, medio is also one common word that goes before an adjective and means 'somewhat' (estoy medio cansado), and the hint does not rule it out; 'not un poco' adds nothing because 'one word' already rules un poco out.
findings.fix: hint: one word, before an adjective; not medio

back.es: algo (adverb) = somewhat, rather, a bit (before an adjective)

note: The adverb card is a good complement to the pronoun card ("I want [something] to eat"), and the two prompts do not overlap.
